summary: Polished scrollbars throughout Project Settings with one PI-aligned themed treatment.
details: Trees, ribbons, tables, editors, pickers, dropdowns, dialogs, and formula areas now share PI-aligned 20px trays with quiet tracks and inset thumbs.
Scrollbar thumbs strengthen on activity or hover, and standard trays use one compact arrow at each end.
The left project tree now matches PI side panels with a transparent lane and no arrow buttons.
